out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Holding Temps
violations.observation: Employees are not routinely monitoring the temperatures of Time/Temperature Control for Safety foods during cold holding.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or Certified Food Manager shall designate employees to monitor the cold holding and hot holding of time/temperature control for safety foods. The employees shall be trained in using a calibrated food thermometer to ensure proper temperatures. Please implement a system for monitoring cold holding and train staff. Please implement your risk control plan within 10 days.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. No CFM was onsite at the start of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM arrived during the inspection.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. Screwtop plastic bottles of water for food employees at the stored at the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. PIC changed the water bottles to containers with a lid and straw.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shell eggs over sauce and raw pork over tofu in the WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM rearranged food.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: meat slicer dirty
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CFM had staff clean the meat slicer.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Enclosed components of ice machine are not being cleaned as required.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. Please clean prior to next inspection.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cut Napa cabbage at at 54F, cut Chinese broccoli at 49F, tofu at 73F, bean sprouts at 66F at cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC put the foods on ice. Food was placed at the cook line 2 hours prior. Cold holding is a repetitive violation. A risk control plan for cold holding will be implemented.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment. The PIC’s food manager certification expired 2/7/26.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. Please renew the CFM certification or get someone else certified within 10 days.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: the PIC touched a container of bean sprouts with a bare hand.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. The EHS educated the PIC about bare hand contact. The sprouts were discarded.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sinks (nos./capacities)
violations.observation: There is not an adequate number of handwashing sinks lavatories on site. The handsink behind the front counter is broken and not usable, so no handsink is available in this area, as required.
violations.corrective_action: At least one hand washing sink, a number of hand washing sinks necessary for their convenient use by employees in areas specified under 5-204.11 and not fewer than the number of hand washing sinks required by Law shall be provided. This needs to be corrected as soon as possible or within 10 days. Replace the damaged hand sink. SISTERS THAI (Inspection Date: 03/31/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: The hand sink at the bar area what do you use to fill water pitch for customers. This sink is for hand washing only.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. The EHS discussed this with the PIC. Discontinue using the bar hand sink to dispense water for customers within 10 days.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. There was no hand soap at the main hand sink in the cooking area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw thawing shrimp was stored over cooked chicken and vegetables in the walk-in.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. The PIC moved the shrimp during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: several foods were uncovered in the walk-in refrigerator, including prepped salads, cut greens, and others.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. All foods in storage in the walk-in must be covered unless they are being cooled. The PIC corrected this during the inspection.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cut greens including Napa and spinach stored on the counter and out of refrigeration were out of temperature at 48º. Bean sprouts were not being held cold enough at 48º. Cooked duck was 48º in the walk-in.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The cooked duck had been received approximately one hour ago. The PIC uncovered the duck to cool it. The bean sprouts were discarded. The PIC was advised to serve the bean sprouts within three hours as they were placed on the counter one hour ago. The PIC requested to use time as a public health control for cut greens and beans sprouts. A TPHC procedure for these foods was created during the inspection and entered into the establishment record. CDI.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Vacuumed packaged (ROP) branzino fish was being thawed in the walk-in without the package being cut open first.
violations.corrective_action: When thawing vacuum packed fish, the package must always be cut open to reduce the risk of anaerobic bacterial growth. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. There was food being stored on the floor in the walk-in refrigerator and the walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Discontinue storing food on the floor and all area areas. Correct as soon as possible or within 90 days.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints. Two food employees in the kitchen were not wearing hair restraints while working with foods.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. Please ensure all employees working with food wear a hat or hairnet while working with foods.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: spoons and scoops for rice were stored in standing water that was 103°F.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. discontinue storing in use utensils in standing water unless the standing water is 135°F. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. SISTERS THAI (Inspection Date: 03/31/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Handled Single-Service/Use Items Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped knives, forks, or spoons were not stored with the handles up at the wait station and at the front counter takeout station.
violations.corrective_action: Knives, forks, and spoons that are not prewrapped shall be presented so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self- service is provided. Store utensils so that the handles are positioned up so that food contact surfaces don’t need to be touched at both locations. Correct as soon as possible or within 10 days.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: aluminum foil is being used to line shelving in several locations in the kitchen. The foil was not clean. It was deteriorated. Aluminum foil is not approved for this use. It is not easily cleanable.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. Change the foil more frequently or discontinue using foil correct as soon as possible or within 90 days.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: several refrigerator door handles had food and debris buildup on them where fingers touch the doors to pull them open.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Clean all the soiled refrigerator door handles to remove the accumulated food and debris. Correct within 10 days.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. Provided covered receptacle in the women’s restroom as soon as possible or within 10 days.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: Observed employee clothing and other possessions stored in areas that may contaminate food, food-contact surfaces of equipment, single-service items, or single- use items. Purses, backpacks and other personal belongings were being stored on food equipment and food storage shelving in several areas in the kitchen. There are lockers provided in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. Discontinue storing personal belongings on food, equipment, and food storage shelving in the kitchen. Utilize the lockers provided. Correct as soon as possible or within 90 days.

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Light Bulbs
violations.observation: There is a light shield missing on the light fixture over the ware washing machine (dishwasher).
violations.corrective_action: Replace the missing light shield as soon as possible or within 90 days.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: all steaks.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. At the bottom of the menu, please add: *This item may be offered raw or uncooked. Consuming raw or uncooked food items may increase your risk for food-borne illness. PIC placed a tent card with the consumer advisory for steak on each table. PIC will email the updated menu to EHS.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: Observed raw chicken in the 3-compartment sink with no running water.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. PIC moved raw chicken into prep sink and completely submerged raw chicken under running water. PIC was informed that staff cannot use the 3-compartment sink for thawing. Thawing must be conducted in the designated prep sink.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: working containers of salt, sugar, pepper, squeeze bottles of oil and vinegar stored on cook line and throughout establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC labeled all working containers and squeeze bottles.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the handwashing sink, located in the bakery
violations.corrective_action: The CFM placed hand soap at the sink, during the inspection for compliance.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the handwashing sink, located in the bakery
violations.corrective_action: The CFM placed paper towels at the hand sink, during the inspection for compliance.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: there were multiple containers in the walk in cooler, with cooked noodles, that had accumulated dirt and grime on the exterior.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM removed the noodles from the containers and discontinued the use of the containers. Noodles were placed in clean containers. New containers were also ordered.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: There was a small accumulation of dirt and/or mold on the interior of the ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM will need to increase cleaning at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. SISTERS THAI (Inspection Date: 01/09/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Cooked noodles on countertop (57F), chopped cabbage on countertop (53F) ( not using TPHC)
violations.corrective_action: The CFM discarded the food items during the inspection for compliance.
